messages.text: Hello place a order a while ago and the phone rang and didn’t get any confirmation payment was placed in bitcoin

Sorry about that. Crypto payments sometimes don't land as an order if the amount sent doesn't match the total exactly, so let's check.

What's the email you used at checkout? I'll look it up right now.
(email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · crypto payment with no matching order; only the team can trace the funds and rai

I checked that email. The only orders on it are from August, both delivered, so the new one didn't come through. When a crypto payment comes in for a slightly different amount than the total, the order doesn't get created on our side, which is almost certainly what happened here.

Georges has been pinged and will pick this up right here in the chat. Stay with us if you can, and if you step away the answer comes to your email.

Meanwhile, what did you order, and roughly when did you send the payment?
I ordered a nano 3s
Searched the catalog · Avalon Nano 3S

Got it, an Avalon Nano 3S. I've passed that to Georges with your email so he can trace the bitcoin payment and get the order raised on our side.

He'll come back to you right here, and by email if you've stepped away. Do you remember roughly what day you sent the payment, and the amount? That makes it much quicker for him to match it.
Payment was sent 3.37pm

Thanks. Was that today, or an earlier day? And do you have the transaction ID from your wallet, or the amount in BTC? Either one lets Georges match the payment straight away.

He has everything so far and will pick this up with you right here.

Perfect, that transaction ID is exactly what Georges needs to trace it. He has it along with your email and the Avalon Nano 3S, and he'll pick this up with you right here.

Stay in the chat if you can. If you step away, the answer comes to (email hidden)
Is he working today George?

Yes, the team is on today. We're open 10am to 6pm Eastern, Monday to Friday, so someone will get to this during today's shift.

Your details are all on the ticket, so nothing needs sending twice. Anything else I can help with while you wait?
Just so you know I hade a code HDMOON so it was 25$ off
Used the store-orders skill

Good news, your order came through while we were talking. It's Shop····, paid in full, total $246.99, so the $25 off is already in that figure.

It's the Avalon Nano 3S (6 TH/s), EU plug, going to (address hidden), plus the Harlo OS diagnostics cover. In stock, ships in 2 business days, and your tracking comes to (email hidden) as soon as the label is made.

Anything else you'd like me to check?
Thank you so much was little nervous a little there
Used the chat-interview skill

Glad it turned out fine, that one had a nervous look to it from your side too.

Before you go, one thing: what made you add the Nano 3S alongside the gear you already run?
Don’t own any Canaan and was the only thing I saw that was in eu warehouse

Fair enough, EU stock makes a real difference on delivery.

Was shipping from inside the EU the deciding thing for you, or was it more about avoiding the customs charges on a unit coming from the US?
Preferably by from eu because I don’t want to pay extra 30% on something

That's exactly right, and good news here: your Nano 3S ships from our Netherlands warehouse, so there's no import VAT or duty on delivery. What you paid is what it costs.

It was really a pleasure sorting this out with you. If you were happy with how it went, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

And you're very welcome in our Discord for new products and help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
Every time I write a review on trustpilot I have to prove to them I actually ordered the item but yes will write a review

Yes, Trustpilot asks for proof on some reviews. Your order number Shop···· and the confirmation email are usually all they want.

Thanks a lot for doing it, and enjoy the Nano 3S when it lands. Just shout here if anything comes up with it.
Thank
Any time. Happy mining, and a copy of this chat comes to your email once we close here.
